coordinate_system: Unicode NFC, normalized newlines, collapsed inline whitespace over production-extracted source text
binary_relevance_rule: A representation chunk is relevant when intersection length divided by canonical gold-span length is at least 0.50, or when it contains the complete normalized annotated fact.
threshold_selection: A priori; must not be tuned on held-out test results.
unresolved_alignment_policy: Do not assign relevance. Send the source/chunk pair to human adjudication.
graded_relevance: Disabled for corpus_v1 unless pilot agreement demonstrates consistent human application.
